title: nf-core/dartseq contrasts schema
description: Schema for the contrasts CSV file used by nf-core/dartseq

contrast_id.errorMessage: Contrast ID must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens

edited_group.errorMessage: Edited group label cannot contain spaces

control_group.errorMessage: Control group label cannot contain spaces

min_edit.errorMessage: min_edit must be a positive integer

max_edit.errorMessage: max_edit must be a positive integer

fold_threshold.errorMessage: fold_threshold must be a positive number

min_sites.errorMessage: min_sites must be a positive integer
